lower_description: flat solid bright green chroma-key color, one uniform green, no texture, no shading, no dithering
upper_description: square chart panel plate for a 16-bit strategy game menu: the whole interior face is light cerulean ocean-blue water with rich detail — small repeating wave crest lines, subtle darker depth blotches and gentle ripple shading across the blue, framed by a richly carved dark walnut wood boundary with visible wood grain strokes, a wide bevel lit warm from the top-left and in deep shadow on the bottom-right, a thin brass inner pinstripe where the wood meets the blue, and a small round brass rosette pinned at each inner corner of the wood, retro 16-bit UI in the style of classic 1990s naval adventure games like Uncharted Waters 2 / New Horizons, crisp deliberate pixels, flat color fills, no text, no icons
transition_description: carved dark walnut wood rim with visible grain ending in a crisp straight edge, a thin brass pinstripe at the wood-to-water boundary, Uncharted Waters 2 wood-bound ocean-chart panel edge
